senses.gloss: c. (סְפַר; cmp. σαμψῆρα Jos. Ant. XX, 2, 2) sword.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 12:18">Targ. Prov. XII, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:15">Targ. Esth. VIII, 15</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21b:2">B. Bath. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>שקל ס׳ למיקטליה</he> he took up a sword to kill him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:4:13">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>טעין חד סַפְסֵר</he> carrying a sword; <he>בהדא ס׳ וכ׳</he> with this sword did Bar N. kill his brother.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:14">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>כי רחימתין עזיזא אפותיא דס׳ וכ׳</he> when our love was strong, we found room to sleep on the broadside of a sword &.; a. e.—Pl. <he>סַפְסֵירֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 30:14">Targ. Prov. XXX, 14</cite> Ms. (ed. <he>סַפְסְרֵי</he>).
